instruction: Explore the FlightAware community discussions and access the 'Feature Requests' or 'Suggestions' category.

metadata.explanation: Variation navigates to feature requests/suggestions category. Uses regex to match possible category names. Maintains similar navigation complexity and pattern as original.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts active tab info including URL via get_active_tab_info (active_tab_info type)
Metric is_expected_url_pattern_match correctly handles both string URLs and dict with 'url' field from getter
Data flow is correct: getter returns dict with 'url' field, metric extracts URL and performs regex matching

Expected regex pattern correctly matches instruction requirements: https://discussions\.flightaware\.com/c/(feature-requests|suggestions|ideas)/ allows for 'Feature Requests' or 'Suggestions' or 'ideas' categories
The regex properly escapes special characters and uses alternation to match category name variations
Coverage is complete: evaluator checks the core requirement of navigating to FlightAware discussions feature requests/suggestions category
Evaluation logic will work correctly at runtime: getter can extract active tab URL, metric can perform regex matching
The inclusion of 'ideas' as a third option makes the verification more flexible and robust to different forum naming conventions
